description: Experiment queue the run belongs to (run_queue.py batch).
MuJoCo Playground environment / task (TesolloCubePinch or TesolloDownwardsRotateZ).
Unique training run name; matches the checkpoint directory under logs/.
Observation/sensor bundle variant (the swept policy axis): none, baseline, proprio.target, proprio.delta, force.magnitude.
Random seed for the run.
Index of the run within its queue.
Queue outcome: ok or failed.
Actor (policy) MLP hidden layer widths, dash-separated.
Critic (value) MLP hidden layer widths, dash-separated.
Observation group fed to the policy network (state = actor observation).
Observation group fed to the value network (privileged_state = asymmetric critic input).
Whether running observation normalization is applied before the networks.
Whether domain randomization was enabled for the run (CLI flag).

Lower bound of per-episode cube-size scaling (TesolloCubePinch). Empty for the current downwards queue, which is the no-DR control sweep (domain_randomization off). Note: for the cube-size-DR downwards variant the range [0.85, 1.15] is baked into the env's domain_randomize and only active when the flag is on.
Upper bound of per-episode cube-size scaling. See cube_size_min note for the downwards env.
Lower bound of cube-mass randomization (TesolloCubePinch only). [1.0, 1.0] means mass is not randomized. Empty for the downwards env.
Upper bound of cube-mass randomization (TesolloCubePinch only).
Lower bound of cube initial-position randomization (TesolloCubePinch only). [0,0] means no position randomization.
Upper bound of cube initial-position randomization (TesolloCubePinch only).
Global observation-noise level applied on top of per-signal scales (0 = off).
Observation-noise scale on joint positions.
Observation-noise scale on joint velocities.
Full per-signal observation-noise scale dict as JSON (complete record; signal keys differ by env).
Whether random external pushes (pert_config) were applied. False for all runs here.
Whether the grasp force target follows a phase-randomized sinusoid (TesolloCubePinch sinusoid queues). Empty = constant set-and-hold force target.
Period of the sinusoidal force target when force_target_sinusoid is true.
Lower bound of the commanded grasp-force target range (TesolloCubePinch).
Upper bound of the commanded grasp-force target range (TesolloCubePinch).
Total environment steps of training.
Number of parallel environments.

Number of minibatches per PPO update.
Number of gradient updates per collected batch.
Rollout unroll length per environment before an update.

PPO entropy bonus coefficient.
Reward discount factor (gamma).
Scalar multiplier applied to rewards.
Gradient-norm clipping threshold. Empty = not set (unclipped) for that run.
Episode horizon in control steps.
Number of physics steps each action is held (1 = no repeat).
Number of evaluation points during training (also sets checkpoint cadence).
Number of env resets performed per evaluation.
Interval between logged training-metric points.

Physics simulation timestep.
